summary: No public gene-level author result was located for the day-8 whole-hypothalamus DSS versus control comparison in E-MTAB-15489. The deposited matrix contains only sample counts, and the closest published whole-hypothalamus comparison uses a separate day-6 DSS cohort.

manualReview.summary: Public-source review located the day-8 hypothalamus counts but no author gene-level result for DSS versus control.
manualReview.note: All 32 measurement columns in raw_counts.tsv match deposited libraries. The eight hypothalamus libraries map to four DSS-treated mice and four controls. The deposit lists no publication, ENA lists reads and GEO has no linked series or sample supplement for this cohort. Literature, preprint, supplement and repository searches found a separate Aberdeen hypothalamus study (PRJNA1378229) with day-6 DSS samples and different BioSample identifiers.
reviewFlags: Author effects, tested-gene coverage, P values and FDR for dss_vs_control remain unassessed.

verificationReview.reason: The deposited gene matrix contains library counts only. The closest whole-hypothalamus RNA-seq publication used a different BioProject, collection time and set of mice.
